tasks.title: PLANS_ROOT
tasks.acceptance: python -c "import sys,pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,'.harness'); from runner import plan; assert plan.PLANS_ROOT=='.harness/plans'; q=chr(34)+'.harness/plans'+chr(34); assert not any(q in pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for f in ['.harness/runner/cli.py','.harness/runner/check.py','.harness/runner/planner.py','.harness/runner/watch.py'])" && python -m pytest -q tests/test_prepare.py tests/test_log_fixes.py tests/test_status.py

tasks.title: drop args.warm
